card.name: Inside proper names and acronyms
card.fires_on: Partway through capitalized proper names or acronyms split into pieces, such as NAOJ, Pranay, Nicarao, Nannup, McNair, Nantucket. It fires on the middle or final piece, often an O or a short syllable.
